name: Skritch 'The Listener' Barrelborn

greeting: Shhh! Not so loud! They might hear!
Skritch knows things. Secrets. For a price. Or a sandwich.
You didn't see me. I wasn't here. This conversation never happened.
The barrels talk. Did you know? They remember things. I listen.
Quiet places. Dark places. That's where truth lives.
Information for sale! Fresh secrets! Hot gossip!
Don't trust the bosses. Either of them. But I can tell you more...
Skritch sees. Skritch hears. Skritch... might tell.
dialog.secrets_for_sale: Got dirt on White. Got dirt on Purple. Got dirt on the foodboys, the snakecharmer, everyone! What's your budget?
dialog.barrel_whispers: Barrels remember. Who made them. What they held. Where they've been. I sleep in barrels. They tell me things. True things.
dialog.backstory: Born in a barrel. Raised in a barrel. Will probably die in a barrel. Not a complaint! Barrels are safe. Warm. Talkative. Better than most people.
rumors: The union dispute? White's scared. Purple knows it. That's why he's pushing.
Something big moved through the Deep Muck last month. Not natural. Not animal. Something... else.
The foodboys aren't really brothers. Found that out by accident. Don't tell them I know.
That iron chef? He used to work the docks. Knows where bodies are buried. Literally, maybe.

time_of_day.morning: Too bright. Too many eyes. Come back later.
time_of_day.noon: Lunch! Got any scraps? Information discount for food!
time_of_day.evening: Good time. Shadows growing. People careless.
time_of_day.night: Night is MY time. Barrels are loudest at night.

mini_quest.stage_1_hook: The Deep Muck... something's there. Something old. The barrels won't stop whispering about it. 'The sunken door,' they say. 'The door that opens down.' I need to know what's there. But I'm... not brave. You look brave.
mini_quest.stage_1_active: Find the sunken door in the Deep Muck. Tell Skritch what lies beyond. The barrels need to know.
mini_quest.stage_2_progress: You've been? To the Deep Muck? Seen the door? What did you find? Tell me!
mini_quest.stage_2_dialogue: An ancient temple? To a serpent god? The barrels were right! They KNEW!
mini_quest.stage_3_complete: The serpent temple... fascinating. The barrels are... excited? Can barrels be excited? Anyway, here's what I promised. My best secret. Hidden treasure cache. Location known only to me and the barrels.

party_reactions.kade: I don't trust him. But his information is usually good.
party_reactions.nix7: Scanning: Subject demonstrates elevated paranoia. Information reliability: 67%.
party_reactions.twist: He's so SMALL! And SNEAKY! Can we keep him?
party_reactions.korr: A creature of shadows. Useful, if unpredictable.
party_reactions.renna: He actually hears magical resonance in contained spaces. Rare talent. Pity about the paranoia.
party_reactions.suresh: The small ones often see what the tall miss. Listen to him.
party_reactions.sova: Useful source. As long as you verify everything.
party_reactions.grit: Every unit needs a scout. He's... one kind of scout.
party_reactions.ashka: He flinches when I get close. Smart goblin.
party_reactions.senna: Finally, someone who understands the value of secrets.
party_reactions.callum: He seems... sad. But helpful! In a creepy way.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New customer. Cash up front. No refunds.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: I remember you. You pay well. I like you.
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite customer! I save the best secrets for you!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You... you treat Skritch like a person. Not a goblin. The barrels say you're good people. They're right.

cross_npc_connections: onionboss_white: White doesn't see me. Good. Lets me watch.
onionboss_purple: Purple sees everyone. Even me. Treats me... nice. Weird.
barrelman_wood: Barkwood's barrels talk the most. Quality wood. Good listeners.
